verdict.rationale: Fathom exposes action items via webhooks and API (fathom-docs-22, fathom-docs-45, fathom-docs-28) and offers an MCP server plus SDKs that an agent could use to build a pipeline into a project tracker (fathom-docs-10, fathom-docs-24), but there is no evidence of a native, pre-built integration or automation targeting Linear, Jira, or Asana specifically — only a generic 'CRM field sync' mention (fathom-docs-12) which is not a project tracker. Missing for 10: documented native connectors/automations for Linear, Jira, or Asana, and an end-to-end example of action items being filed into a tracker.
